title: Core normalized generic data
statement: The normalized generic data conclusion of lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-normalized-generic-data, omitting its final geometric-point lifting clause.

proof.text: Convert the finite-value constructibility hypothesis using isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff, pull it back along X.fromSpecResidueField x with IsConstructibleSheaf.upperStar, and convert back. Apply constructible_field_finite_separable_constant to this residue-field pullback, obtaining a finite-dimensional separable extension K and a finite module M with a trivialization e on Spec K.

Noetherian X is quasi-separated. Apply normalization_in_finite_residue_field_extension to K. Obtain integral nu:Y -> X, integral Y with integrally closed stalks, g:Spec K -> Y, the equality g followed by nu = the extension map followed by the residue-field inclusion, and generic image and residue-field isomorphism of g.

Identify the image of the unique point of Spec K with genericPoint Y. Both source and target stalks at these points are fields, so their residue quotient maps are bijective. The residue-field square and the residue-field isomorphism of g make its stalk map an isomorphism. Thus phi = stalkClosedPointTo g is an isomorphism, and Spec.map phi followed by Y.fromSpecStalk at the generic point equals g. Apply the normal constant generic unit theorem at Y.fromSpecStalk. Inverse image along the source isomorphism is an equivalence, so its unit is invertible. The composition-unit equation expresses the unit for g, followed by an isomorphism, as the canonical generic unit followed by a direct image of the source-isomorphism unit and another isomorphism. Cancel the final isomorphism. This is the fully proved private helper isIso_unit_constantSheaf_of_generic_residueFieldIso.

Use the inverse-image composition isomorphism for g and nu, transport across the normalization factorization equality, and use the composition isomorphism for the field-extension map and the residue-field inclusion. Compose with e and the inverse of upperStarConstantSheafIso at M. This identifies g^*nu^*F with g^*M_Y. Package Y, nu, K, g, M, their integrality and finiteness, the unit isomorphism, and this trivialization.

theorem exists_constructible_module_normalized_generic_data_core
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F) (x : X) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (ν : Y ⟶ X), IsIntegralHom ν ∧
      ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Y)
        (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), Finite M ∧
        IsIso ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).unit.app
          ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) ∧
        Nonempty
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj F) ≅
           (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj
            ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))
